# The Season Ledger
The Company's cheerful term for your permanent record. Every season, it decides who you are.
- What it is: your cumulative, cross-round career history — shifts served ("tours"), Standing earned, contracts completed, and more. It is what your in-game rank and any earned title are computed from, not just how you did this single round.
- Where to find it: your current title and rank, when you have one, are visible on your character record; a title ceremony announces new grants directly when they happen.
- How titles are earned: high career Standing and tenure earn rank and title advancement each season. Low Standing simply means slower advancement — the Ledger has no punitive track, only a slower one.
- Steps to first success: there is no console to click for this one. Play shifts, complete Contracts Board work and bounties, and let your career totals accumulate. Titles and rank changes announce themselves; you do not need to check anything manually.
- Season boundaries reset the [italic]current-season[/italic] view of some numbers, but never your career totals — a season bump cannot make Standing you already earned disappear.
